finalText:
**94 files touch `account_id`. Three spots must stay frozen.**

The other ~90 are internal repo, service, and route files across `orders`, `billing`, `notify`, `analytics`, `accounts` — safe to rename.

| Location | Why frozen |
|---|---|
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | vendored, generated, marked do-not-edit |
| `lib/serialize.js` | `WIRE` map locks `account_id` as the public API field name |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | public request and response field, explicitly frozen |

The 12 files in `migrations/` are applied production history. Editing them renames nothing live and breaks the down step. A real rename needs a new migration plus every raw SQL query updated in step.

`lib/audit.js` also keys log lines by `account_id` — confirm with whoever owns the audit trail before touching it.

Don't sign off today. The public API contract blocks a full rename.
